title: Entropy bounded by the logarithm of the alphabet size
statement:
Let $S$ be a finite nonempty set, let $(\Omega,\mu)$ be a measure space, and let $X\colon\Omega\to S$ be a random variable. If $N$ is a natural number with $\abs{S}\le N$, then the Shannon entropy of $X$ satisfies
\[
  H[X;\mu]\;\le\;\log N.
\]
hypotheses_covered: S is a finite type (Fintype S)
N is a natural number with card(S) ≤ N
X : Ω → S is a random variable on the measure space (Ω, μ)
replaced:
If the alphabet type $S$ has $\mathrm{card}(S) \le N$, then for any random variable
$X : \Omega \to S$ and measure $\mu$,
\[
  H[X;\mu] \;\le\; \log N.
\]
